# P22 (process)
# generated by gen_views.py; sources: elements.jsonl 2914ff484cea963e

After placement ends, members contest which version of the canvas and of the event is kept: they ask a cleanup of a shared copy to fix their work, take part in it, argue that the cleanup should keep the damage as history, and correct accounts of the event that describe their group wrongly.
